transcript: You must learn to listen when your body whispers. Before anxiety or stress arrives, your body always gives you signs, a tight jaw, a restless night, a heaviness in your chest you try to ignore. You call it just a busy week. You call it I'm just tired. But your body is not confused. It knows when you are pushing too far. It knows when something is not aligned. It knows when you are carrying what is not yours. Anxiety doesn't come out of nowhere. It builds in silence. Now here is the solution. When the whisper comes, do not fight it. Do not distract yourself. Do not scroll it away. Pause. Close your eyes. Take one slow breath in through your nose. Hold it. Release it slowly through your mouth. Do this five times. Slow enough that your body feels it. Then ask yourself quietly, what am I carrying that is not mine? What am I forcing that is not flowing? Where am I betraying myself? Most anxiety is not random. It is misalignment. So simplify. Sleep earlier. Drink water. Move your body. Say no when you mean no. Have the hard conversation. Remove one thing from your schedule. You do not need to fix your whole life in one day. You need to calm your nervous system first. When the body feels safe, the mind becomes clear. When the mind becomes clear, the right decision appears. Stillness is medicine. Breath is power. Boundaries are protection. If you are tired of ignoring the whispers. I created a 30-day healing journey to help you slow down, reset your nervous system, and return to yourself. It's in the link in my profile.
